purpose: Immediate pre-release fact refresh for every load-bearing claim in the Surrey tree-sale candidate.

factsConfirmed: The first online sale opens August 18 at 9 a.m., with pickup September 13 at the Surrey Operations Centre.
The second online sale opens September 29, with pickup October 25.
Each sale offers approximately 1,000 trees on a first-come, first-served basis.
The dated release says buyers can purchase two trees per sale.
The August 18 online store opens at 9 a.m. and runs until September 1 while supplies last; pickup is September 13.
The September 29 online store opens at 9 a.m. and runs until October 13 while supplies last; pickup is October 25.
The program is for private properties in Surrey and Surrey residents.
The purchasing card must use a Surrey billing name and address.
The eligibility section says a maximum of two trees per Surrey address, based on the billing address.
The tree-list section separately says two trees per household.
All trees cost $20; most are in 3- or 5-gallon pots and stand 5 to 12 feet tall.
Pickup is at the Surrey Operations Centre, 6651 148 Street, and buyers choose a pickup time at checkout.
Items in a cart are not held until payment has been processed.
Each sale has approximately 1,000 trees, first come, first served.
The live August list includes apple, cherry, plum, dogwood, magnolia, and maple categories.
